item.title: Fellowship Info Session to Highlight Competitions for Grad School Tuition and Salary Oct. 14, 2pm
item.description: Competitive fellowships provide salary and tuition for masters and PhD students. Juniors, seniors, and graduate students will learn how to find and apply to appropriate programs that will fund fall of 2027 and beyond. Funding opportunities are available for all stages of your academic career. International students are welcome! Register for the virtual session at https://surveys.rpi.edu/jfe/form/SV_6L3FFwv0qCROrvE Questions? madige@rpi.edu

item.description: Date: Tuesday, October 6, 2026 10:00 PM - Wed , October 7, 2026 12:00 AM - Learn to curl! item.title: Show, Don’t Tell: Make Your Grad Essay Stand Out (Writing Lab Workshop)
item.description: October 7th, 2026: 4-5pm in the Fishbach Room, Folsom Library A strong application essay relies on specific evidence rather than general claims. This workshop covers the “show, don’t tell” principle and how to use concrete examples and details to support statements about a student’s strengths, interests, and goals. Students will leave with strategies for revising general statements into more persuasive, evidence-based writing.

item.title: Add Business Skills and Expand Your Opportunities: An Accelerated Master’s at Lally with Credit Sharing
item.description: Complete your master’s and rise into leadership faster. Lally is the only school at RPI where 6 undergraduate credits also count toward your master’s, so most students complete the degree in two extra semesters or less. Engineers, scientists, and students from every major can add business, analytics, finance, supply chain, and management skills that expand career opportunities and leadership capabilities. Join an info session October 6 or 20, 4-5 p.m., Lally Hall 104. Snacks provided!

item.title: Pittsburgh Building Crane Work and Access Closures – October 3, 2026
item.description: On Saturday, October 3, from 7:00 a.m. to noon, a crane will be positioned on the north side of the Pittsburgh Building for AHU cold water coil work. The roadway from 8th Street to the Walker Laboratory Building and walkways between Amos Eaton and the Pittsburgh Building, including those in front of Pittsburgh, will be closed during this time. Barricades, cones, and personnel will be in place to direct pedestrians around the work area. Please plan to use alternate routes.

item.title: Getting the Most from Percipio : “Assigning Learning in Percipio: A Guide for Supervisors:”
item.description: This course provides supervisors with a step-by-step overview of how to assign learning content to employees using Percipio. You’ll learn how to search for relevant courses, create and manage assignments, track completion, and support your team’s development goals. Designed to be quick and practical, this session equips you with the tools needed to guide your team’s learning journey effectively.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Reminder for Faculty: NSF GRFP Letters of Recommendation due Oct. 16th
item.description:
Letters of recommendation for students applying to the NSF GRFP are due October 16th, days BEFORE the students applications are due. Students will not be able to submit their applications if your recommendations are not entered by the deadline. Encourage your students to seek a review from Betty Madigan prior to submitting their applications: formatting requirements have changed! Faculty may also request feedback on their recommendation letters. Send any drafts or questions to madige@rpi.edu.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
